requirement: Describe an open-label Phase II single-arm study of G-FLIP plus intravenous ascorbic acid in advanced pancreatic cancer, with G-FLIP-DM used as a rescue regimen after disease progression.

evidence.text: The protocol cover and synopsis define the phase, open-label regimen, and progression-triggered rescue.
The analysis plan explicitly calls the efficacy study single-arm.

requirement: Do not describe the main efficacy study as a two-arm randomized trial: all participants receive the active regimen; randomization concerns only immediate versus two-cycle-delayed ascorbic-acid initiation for an acute-safety comparison.

evidence.text: The synopsis states all subjects receive G-FLIP and assigns half to delayed ascorbic acid.
The SAOP confirms no concurrent efficacy control and a separate timing comparison for safety.

requirement: Target 30 evaluable participants, with approximately 15 assigned to immediate ascorbic acid and 15 to a two-cycle delay.

evidence.text: The protocol gives the evaluable target and timing allocation.

requirement: Define the primary efficacy endpoint as the proportion alive 12 months after accrual, while separately recording 12-month survival from diagnosis.

evidence.text: The synopsis identifies the primary endpoint and defines both time origins.
The SAOP confirms 12-month survival as primary.

requirement: Include overall survival, progression-free survival, confirmed RECIST 1.1 response rate, quality of life, CA 19-9, and safety as secondary or supportive outcomes.

evidence.text: The protocol lists and defines the secondary efficacy domains.
The SAOP adds CA 19-9 and maps outcomes to analyses.

requirement: Define confirmed response as complete or partial response on two consecutive CT or MRI scans under RECIST 1.1 and define PFS from first documented stable disease or better to progression or death.

evidence.text: The protocol provides response and PFS derivations.

requirement: Estimate OS and PFS distributions with Kaplan-Meier methods and report medians with appropriate 95% confidence intervals.

evidence.text: The SAOP specifies Kaplan-Meier distributions and median confidence intervals.

requirement: Use the historical FOLFIRINOX Phase III trial only as contextual cross-reference for survival and response; do not present it as a concurrent randomized control or make causal treatment comparisons.

evidence.text: The SAOP proposes cross-reference to a historical FOLFIRINOX trial while identifying the current study as single-arm.

requirement: Compare repeated QOL and CA 19-9 measurements across baseline, G-FLIP, and G-FLIP-DM periods using within-subject analysis of variance.

evidence.text: The SAOP specifies within-subject ANOVA for QOL and CA 19-9.

requirement: Treat the comparison of response during G-FLIP versus the post-progression G-FLIP-DM rescue period as a within-subject exploratory analysis and explicitly acknowledge time-varying disease-selection bias.

evidence.text: Only patients progressing on G-FLIP receive G-FLIP-DM.
The SAOP proposes within-subject ANOVA and recognizes lower expected rescue response.

requirement: Tabulate vital signs, laboratory parameters, and adverse drug reactions for all participants and grade adverse reactions using the current NCI CTCAE version.

evidence.text: The protocol enumerates safety assessments.
The SAOP specifies all-subject tabulation and CTCAE grading.

requirement: Compare safety during the first four weeks between immediate and delayed ascorbic-acid groups using a between-subject analysis, restricted to the acute-safety timing contrast.

evidence.text: The timing randomization is intended to compare potential acute safety.
The SAOP prespecifies between-subject ANOVA over the four-week timing window.

requirement: Confirm whether the primary 12-month survival denominator is all enrolled, all treated, or the protocol's undefined evaluable population and specify treatment attribution for safety and rescue-period analyses.

evidence.text: The protocol uses both all-participant and evaluable language without a full analysis-set definition.

requirement: Specify censoring and missing-data rules for OS, PFS, response, QOL, CA 19-9, and the 12-month survival proportion; do not infer complete-case handling from silence.

evidence.text: The protocol defines follow-up and assessment timing but not analysis censoring or missingness.
The short SAOP also omits these rules.

requirement: Confirm whether any hypothesis testing is inferential in this small single-arm study and define multiplicity and a study-level success criterion; otherwise label all analyses descriptive or exploratory.

evidence.text: No powered hypothesis or study-level success rule is supplied.
The SAOP lists several analyses without multiplicity or inferential hierarchy.
